name: badge
title: Badge
description: A compound badge component with variants, colors, sizes, dot indicators, and polymorphic icon support. Uses namespace exports: Badge.Root, Badge.Icon, Badge.Dot.

migration.guide: Badge v2 is a full rewrite using tv (tailwind-variants) and compound components. Replace `<Badge colorVar="blueFilled">` with `<Badge.Root variant="filled" color="blue">`. Icons now use `<Badge.Icon as={Icon} />` instead of the `icon` prop. A new `<Badge.Dot />` sub-component replaces dot indicators. The `cva` and `happly-ui-utils` dependencies are no longer needed.

docs.lead: A compound badge component with variants, colors, sizes, dot indicators, and polymorphic icon support.
docs.usage:
import * as Badge from "@/components/ui/badge"

<Badge.Root variant="filled" color="blue">
  <Badge.Icon as={RiFlashlightFill} />
  Badge
</Badge.Root>

examples.title: Filled Variant
examples.description: The filled variant uses the color's 500 token as background with white text.

examples.title: Light Variant
examples.description: The light variant uses the color's 200 token as background and 950 for text.

examples.title: Lighter Variant
examples.description: The lighter variant uses the color's 50 token for background, 100 for the border, and 950 for text.

examples.title: Stroke Variant
examples.description: The stroke variant uses a neutral-200 border on a white background with the color's 500 text.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: All 11 available color options across the design system, including primary.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Badges come in small (default) and medium sizes, with both icon and dot sub-components.

examples.title: Square
examples.description: Use the square prop for compact numeric badges.

examples.title: With Icon
examples.description: Use Badge.Icon with the `as` prop for polymorphic icon rendering.

examples.title: With Dot
examples.description: Use Badge.Dot for a small status dot indicator.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.code:
<Badge.Root variant="filled" color="red" disabled>Badge</Badge.Root>
<Badge.Root variant="stroke" color="blue" disabled>Badge</Badge.Root>

examples.title: As Child
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render as a different element.

examples.title: Group Default
examples.description: Badge.Group defaults to gray lighter badges with a stroke toggle.
examples.code:
<Badge.Group
  maxVisible={3}
  items={[
    { label: 'React' },
    { label: 'TypeScript' },
    { label: 'Tailwind' },
    { label: 'Node.js' },
    { label: 'GraphQL' },
    { label: 'Docker' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Group
examples.description: Use Badge.Group to render a list of badges with a collapsible show more/less toggle.
examples.code:
<Badge.Group
  maxVisible={3}
  variant="lighter"
  items={[
    { label: 'React', color: 'blue' },
    { label: 'TypeScript', color: 'purple' },
    { label: 'Tailwind', color: 'sky' },
    { label: 'Node.js', color: 'green' },
    { label: 'GraphQL', color: 'pink' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Group Expanded
examples.description: Badge.Group without maxVisible shows all badges with no toggle.
examples.code:
<Badge.Group
  variant="filled"
  items={[
    { label: 'Design', color: 'purple' },
    { label: 'Code', color: 'blue' },
    { label: 'Ship', color: 'green' },
  ]}
/>

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Badge.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon container that receives variant props from Badge.Root.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as

api.name: Badge.Dot
api.description: A small dot indicator that inherits color from Badge.Root.

api.name: Badge.Group
api.description: A composed component that renders a list of badges with an optional collapsible toggle.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of badge items to render. Each item has label, and optional variant, color, size, icon, and dot.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Maximum badges visible before collapsing. Shows all when omitted.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shared variant for all badges (overridden by per-item variant)

props.name: color
props.description: Shared color for all badges (overridden by per-item color)

props.name: size
props.description: Shared size for all badges (overridden by per-item size)

props.name: toggleVariant
props.description: Variant for the show more/less toggle badge

props.name: toggleColor
props.description: Color for the show more/less toggle badge
